questions.question: After the wall of Jerusalem was rebuilt, what did Nehemiah set in place?
Why did Nehemiah put Hananiah, the commander of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem?

answers.text: He was faithful and feared God more than most
He had fought off the enemies at the wall
He knew every family living in the city

questions.question: After the wall was rebuilt, Nehemiah told Jerusalem's leaders to open the city gates at first light. True or false?
When Nehemiah gathered the people of Jerusalem to be counted by family line, what did he find?

answers.text: The register of those who first returned
A letter from the king of Persia
The scroll of the Law of Moses
